verdict_reason: Correct mapping of MDM /commodities, but four of its six fields are unread by any production code.

todos.issue: MdmCommodity declares description (l.10), isSelectable (l.12), speciesCount (l.13) and species/scientificNames (l.14), but nothing in src/main reads them: CommoditySearchService only calls code() and isGerminal(). Breaks 'Build only what this change makes reachable'; Spring Boot's ObjectMapper ignores unknown JSON properties, so the fields are not needed to deserialise.
todos.fix: Must: MdmCommodity holds only the fields production code reads (code, isGerminal) and gains others in the change that first reads them. One way: delete description, isSelectable, speciesCount and species, and the builder calls in MdmServiceTest/CommoditySearchServiceTest that set them.
